name: The Sea Hotel
accommodation: 34 en-suite rooms: single, twin, double and family, including accessible rooms
suitableFor: Couples, families and groups wanting a seafront hotel
beachAccess: On the seafront overlooking South Marine Park; Littlehaven Beach on the doorstep
confirmedFeatures: Bar 52, restaurant, room service, function rooms, residents' lounge, free Wi-Fi, cycle parking
overview: A traditional hotel on South Shields seafront overlooking South Marine Park, with Littlehaven Beach just across the road. Its 34 en-suite rooms include family and accessible options, and there is a bar, restaurant and function suite on site. The town centre is around five minutes' walk, and the Metro is 10 to 15 minutes on foot.
surfTripFit: Littlehaven and the pier are right on the doorstep, and secure parking keeps the car and boards close.
